[b]Translations[/b]
Translations are welcome. Pleaselet me know and link the translation to this mod.
[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install theLatest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract ContentPatcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract theGeneric Mod Config Menu mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿ (optional
but recommended)
4. Download and Extract [b]Shops sell Related Books [/b]into yourStardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
5. Launch Stardew Valley. Toenable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the
Stardew Valley title screen.
[b]Dialogue[/b]
All of my mods work together.Dialogue related to stores selling items is optional.
